# What Shopify access tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is: a body is thirty-two hexadecimal characters, so the run twice
# over is one, and the six character prefix in front brings a token to
# thirty-eight. Where a case turns on the case a body is written in, the same run
# is written as 0123456789ABCDEF instead.

patterns: shopify-access-token

# The three prefixes Shopify writes an access token with, one to a kind: shpat_
# for the token a public app receives for a shop, shpca_ for the token a custom
# app is given, shppa_ for the token its changelog assigns to a legacy private
# app and its reference page to a delegate token. They are one pattern because a
# caller with reason to redact any of them has the same reason for the rest, and
# the cases below are the three of them in the places a token is written.

case:     a public app access token in an environment assignment
in:       SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN=shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN=«shopify-access-token»

case:     a token in the header the admin api reads it from
in:       X-Shopify-Access-Token: shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      X-Shopify-Access-Token: «shopify-access-token»

case:     a custom app access token in a json body
in:       {"access_token":"shpca_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","scope":"read_products"}
out:      {"access_token":"«shopify-access-token»","scope":"read_products"}

case:     a delegate access token beside the token it was minted from
in:       {"parent":"shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","delegate":"shppa_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"}
out:      {"parent":"«shopify-access-token»","delegate":"«shopify-access-token»"}

case:     a token in the command line a request is made from
in:       curl -H 'X-Shopify-Access-Token: shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef' https://example.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/shop.json
out:      curl -H 'X-Shopify-Access-Token: «shopify-access-token»' https://example.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/shop.json

# The alphabet the thirty-two characters are written in: hexadecimal in either
# case, which is what all four published rulesets reading this format ask for and
# what a body trufflehog ships in its own tests carries both of. The prefix is
# read in lowercase alone, and the pattern's own file weighs what reading the
# uppercase shape would cost. What the alphabet leaves out is everything else,
# the letters past f and the two characters base64url adds among them, so a run
# carrying any of those is no token.

case:     a body written in uppercase
in:       shpat_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF
out:      «shopify-access-token»

case:     a body written in both cases at once
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789ABCDEF
out:      «shopify-access-token»

case:     a letter past f in the body is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdefg123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdefg123456789abcdef

case:     an uppercase letter past f in the body is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789ABCDEFG123456789ABCDEF
out:      shpat_0123456789ABCDEFG123456789ABCDEF

case:     a space in the body is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef 123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdef 123456789abcdef

case:     a hyphen in the body is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef

case:     an underscore in the body is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef_123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdef_123456789abcdef

case:     a forbidden character at the first body position with a full run behind it
in:       shpat_g0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_g0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     an uppercase prefix is the shape a variable's name is written in
in:       SHPAT_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHPAT_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a hyphen where the separator stands
in:       shpat-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpat-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     the separator missing altogether
in:       shpat0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
out:      shpat0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0

case:     the opening missing its first character
in:       hpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
out:      hpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0

case:     the right shape with no prefix in front of it
in:       xxxxx_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      xxxxx_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a custom app token with a body one character short
in:       shpca_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      shpca_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a private app token in a case an environment variable's name is written in
in:       SHPPA_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHPPA_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# The count is exact. A body one character short is no token at all, and a run
# longer than the count is a token with something written after it — only the
# token is redacted.

case:     a body one character short is no token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde
out:      shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcde

case:     a run longer than the count is a token and what follows it
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
out:      «shopify-access-token»0

# The token format this one replaced, which Shopify's changelog says existing
# tokens go on working in: thirty-two characters with no prefix in front of
# them. That is a bare digest's shape, so it is left in the output whole rather
# than every hexadecimal identifier a caller passes through being redacted with
# it.

case:     the token format this one replaced
in:       SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     a kind shopify names no prefix for
in:       shpua_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpua_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

case:     three characters where two name the kind
in:       shpatx_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpatx_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

# There is no word boundary either side of a match, so a token written straight
# against a name or a letter is redacted rather than left whole.

case:     a token written straight against a name
in:       TOKEN_shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      TOKEN_«shopify-access-token»

case:     a custom app token written straight against a name
in:       TOKEN_shpca_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      TOKEN_«shopify-access-token»

case:     a token written straight against a letter
in:       xshpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      x«shopify-access-token»

case:     a token written straight in front of a letter of its own class
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
out:      «shopify-access-token»0

case:     an uppercase letter past f written straight after a token
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefG
out:      «shopify-access-token»G

case:     a token at the end of a sentence
in:       the token is shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.
out:      the token is «shopify-access-token».

case:     a token after a digit
in:       9shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      9«shopify-access-token»

case:     a token after a hyphenated word
in:       store-shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      store-«shopify-access-token»

case:     a token immediately against japanese on both sides
in:       トークンはshpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefです
out:      トークンは«shopify-access-token»です

case:     two tokens with nothing between them
in:       shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdefshppa_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      «shopify-access-token»«shopify-access-token»

case:     a candidate whose body opens with a prefix
in:       shpat_shpat_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
out:      shpat_«shopify-access-token»

# Prose, and the shapes an ordinary line carries that open a candidate and close
# it again.

case:     prose naming a shop and an app
in:       the shop app posted an update to the storefront this morning
out:      the shop app posted an update to the storefront this morning

case:     a log line carrying the shop's host name and no token
in:       time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling admin api" url=https://example.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/shop.json
out:      time=2026-08-17T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling admin api" url=https://example.myshopify.com/admin/api/2026-07/shop.json
